lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with each column containing between 3 and 5 distinct spots of varying pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming a recognizable grid-like structural pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition where light intensity on the upper edge shifts into shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white focal lesion or structural notch is visible on the posterior-distal margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least six commensal Echeneidae (remoras) is visible swimming in the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
